_doc: Fixed run protocol for the fx 554 consolidation pass (prompt 5Q, 2026-10-05). Read by batch.sh and check_run.py. Values are rules fixed before data, not measurements; a change after the first table run is a POST-HOC DEVIATIONS entry.
start: 20 m on the sign line, z 7.5, fixed hold (config/sim_geometry.json start_xyz_yaw; config/held_reference.json)
controller: ibvs, SLAM pose and depth off; stack config ours_fx554_A_ibvs (NPU, placement A) or ours_fx554_B_ibvs (CPU, placement B)
t14_bins_note: horizontal range to the frozen sign, lo <= r < hi, as inloop_accuracy.py --bins
geometry_gate_note: 40 px x 554 / 1200 = 18.47 px at capture (inloop_accuracy.py default_rms_gate); check_run requires the scorer's rms_gate_px to equal this within 0.01
standoff_note: expected standoff from the pinned FSM ratios read from each run's params dump: d(r) = cam_fy * sign_height_m / (r * image_height); vx -> 0 at target_bbox_ratio, REACHED needs >= hold_bbox_ratio. Reported per run with the closest approach and the overshoot, whether or not overshoot happens.
npu_open_budget_note: INFERRED from two boots on Pi-3 (2026-10-04, 2026-10-05): the Hailo-10H returned ENXIO after about 70 successful VDevice opens per boot. 60 leaves a margin. Count = 'Creating vdevice' lines in ~/.hailo/hailort/hailort.log since boot.

sentinel.note: first run of every session, not counted in a row; A3 means (DEVIATIONS 17.57), latency rule 17.59 (f)
